title: Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan could all hike in 10 days. What a global rate wave means for India
short: Fed, ECB and BoJ could all hike within 10 days. Why India cares
dek: After 32 rate cuts in 2025, the world's big central banks are raising rates again, many of them at the same time. December could bring three hikes in ten days. Here's how that ripples into the rupee, Indian bonds and the RBI.
card: The Fed, the ECB and the Bank of Japan meet between 8 and 18 December, and markets expect all three to hike.
